text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the school building, 
I saw Kitasan Black walking with a beaming 
smile behind an anxious Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A-And now! On your right, you'll see a 
spot that is very popular among the 
academy's students!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you feel frustrated from losing, 
you just shout 'Waaah!' right at that 
tree!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, understood, Spe-san! Fufu, next up 
is—ah!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Helloooo!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Kita-san's Trainer!? Th-Thank you for 
taking such good care of her...!
choice_data_list:
The pleasure is mine, thanketh thou for 
all thy support...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. The way you two are talking is 
getting pretty funny, you know? Relax a 
little more, relax~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All riiight, inha~le... exha~le...
choice_data_list: By the way, what were you doing?
By the way, what were you doing?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah! Well, you see...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! Regrettably, Kita-chan, I have 
official business with the President 
today, so I cannot keep you company!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Eeeek, is that true~?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Umu. And so, I have prepared a stand-in. 
My friend, Special Week-kun!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! I'm Special Week! I'll be in your 
care!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nishishi, you're way too stiff, Spe-chan~! 
You're a senior now too, so show a little 
more dignity~.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Teio. This inspection was 
supposed to be conducted by me alone, 
however...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, no, no, Pre-zi-dent! I decided today 
that I'm gonna help you! So take me with 
youuu~!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And so, Spe-san is looking after me today 
in place of Teio-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
W-When it comes to "taking care" of 
someone as an upperclassman! Naturally, 
that means a campus tour!! Now, um, other 
places I can show you... Hmmm!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Kitasan Black has been enrolled 
for quite a while now, so a campus tour 
shouldn't be necessary at this point...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san. Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, I just want to indulge in 
Spe-san's kindness. As her 'junior.'"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Though it seems you've already introduced 
me plenty enough... Hmm, let me see...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, I want to do tandem runs with 
you, Senpai, and get some recommendations 
for the school cafeteria!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I've heard all about your amazing 
achievements, Spe-san, and I'd love to 
know the secret behind your strength~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: O-Ohh~... I see, I see. Understood!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It kind of feels like the roles of senior 
and junior have completely flipped when it 
comes to who's taking the lead, though...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Trainer, which one do you 
think is better?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black makes eye contact. It seems 
she is intent on showing deference to her 
senior as a junior.
choice_data_list:
I was hoping you'd be my partner for some 
side-by-side training!
Want to grab a meal together?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah! Leave it to me!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All riiight, Kita-san! Let's go for one 
more lap~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, next time I'll make sure to cross the 
finish line before getting overtaken!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ooh. Kita-chan, you and Spe-chan have 
gotten so close~!
choice_data_list:
Huh, weren't you supposed to be on an 
inspection...?

Huh, weren't you supposed to be on an 
inspection...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I cut things short and came back. 
Even after walking outside, I couldn't get 
the two of them out of my head.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Accompanying you to work in that condition 
would be bad for the President, too. So 
today, I think I'll prioritize being your 
"senior."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, looks like there was no need to 
worry after all. Kita-chan, no matter who 
she's up against—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—You're a genius at getting people to open 
up.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Right away!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Spe-san! They have miso ramen on 
today's menu!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Kita-san. Actually, they 
have a secret menu for that.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Behold... We can double the soft-boiled 
eggs...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Waaah... double the points...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In complete contrast to earlier, perhaps 
because it was her home turf, Special Week 
was now putting on airs as a senior to 
Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, as expected of Spe-san. You really 
know everything when it comes to food!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! Leave it to me! You can count on me 
for anything♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a way, I thought Kitasan Black's charm 
as a junior might have given Special Week 
some breathing room.
